issues.legal_issue: The criteria adopted by the State of Goa for identifying private forests are adequate and valid and do not require modification to use the Forest Survey of India’s one-hectare and 10-percent canopy-density parameters.
The National Green Tribunal had jurisdiction to consider the challenge to the forest-identification criteria and to direct the completion of the identification and demarcation process.
The challenge to the existing forest-identification criteria was barred by principles of finality, including estoppel and res judicata.
The identification criteria for forests may differ among States, and no uniform nationwide criteria are required.
